paper_title: Particle dispersion in the classical vector dark matter background
coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing epsilon; values are eps = g_e/e with e=0.303 applied to the paper's g_psi bound of Eq. (39)
notes: Theory paper deriving new bounds on ultralight vector DM from in-medium dispersion/normalization effects. For the dark photon model (Fig. 6), two new bounds are derived: (i) electron mass measurement, g_e < 3.3e-12*(m/1e-20 eV) [Eq. 35], and (ii) wavefunction normalization / electroweak precision (Z line), g < 6.6e-39*(m/1e-20 eV)^2 [Eq. 39]. The Eq. 39 bound is stronger throughout the plotted ultralight mass range, so the emitted curve is Eq. 39 converted to kinetic mixing via eps = g/e (e = 0.303). Paper also derives bounds for L_mu-L_tau, L_e-L_mu/tau, and B-L models (g_BL couplings) which are not included here; only the dark photon result is extracted per the hint.
